items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: Yeah, we got Harvey Liferbuss on the boat at first

ctx.x: Yeah, we got Harvey Liferbuss on the boat at first when we were on another trombone player. We got Zoo Robertson and they got Johnny Lindsey. That's when they used to come on the boat. Johnny Lindsey would be sitting up behind the bass and they'd think it was me. We looked a whole lot alike. Did he play bass or did he play trombone? We played trombone and bass.
The Stratford's people they liked it, Johnny and George, very much. They liked it.
